data.name: Priyanka
data.gender_notes: Priyanka is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is beloved, dear, precious, lovable, attractive, and kind. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'priy' meaning 'beloved' and 'anka' meaning 'one'. The name Priyanka carries the meaning “Loved One, Beloved, Sweet One” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Priyanka usually hope their child will grow to embody loved one, beloved, sweet one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner beauty, grace, and charm of an individual. Encourages self-love, kindness, and compassion towards oneself and others.
